**Churn rate by contract type**

| Contract Type   | Total Customers | Churned Customers | Churn Rate (%) |
|-----------------|----------------:|------------------:|----------------:|
| One year        | 1,473 | 166 | 11.27% |
| Month‑to‑month  | 3,875 | 1,655 | 42.71% |
| Two year        | 1,695 | 48 | 2.83% |

**Interpretation**

- **Month‑to‑month** customers have the highest churn rate (≈ 43 %), indicating they are the most likely to leave.
- **One‑year** contracts see a moderate churn rate (~11 %).
- **Two‑year** contracts have the lowest churn rate (≈ 3 %), suggesting longer‑term contracts are effective at retaining customers.
sql: SELECT Contract, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN Churn='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churn_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Churn='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_rate_percent FROM customers GROUP BY Contract
